newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish banks lend PLN 98.5 mln to power plant.
newsitem.headline: Polish banks lend PLN 98.5 mln to power plant.

text.p: A consortium of Polish banks, led by state-owned Pekao SA, signed a 98.5 million zloty loan agreeement with power plant Zespol Elektrowni Dolna Odra, Pekao SA said in a statement on Thursday.
Other banks in the consortium include the state-owned Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA, Bank Handlowy SA and its Luxembourg unit -- Bank Handlowy International SA Luxembourg.
The power plants will use the loan to modernise two power generating blocks at the plants located on Western Polish border Odra river. @
This loan completes the financing for the power plants' 170 million zloty modernisation scheme, which also included a 35 million zloty investment credit from Pekao SA.
